data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at the start of 2018 were GBP 12.683m. During 2018 the Syndicate increased gross prior year claims provisions by GBP 3.248m (strengthening), representing a c.25.6% increase versus opening gross reserves. The report provides no specific event attribution; the movement is recorded in the technical provisions reconciliation and consistent with adverse prior-year development / IBNR recalibration on the Syndicate's treaty reinsurance book.
raw_causal_phrases: The provision for claims outstanding comprises the estimated cost of settling all claims incurred but unpaid at the balance sheet date, whether reported or not.
The amount included in respect of IBNR is based on statistical techniques of estimation applied by the Syndicate managing agent's actuaries and reviewed by external consulting actuaries.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement (gross +3,248k) was taken from Note 11 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross column). No textual explanation or event attribution provided. The syndicate underwrites quota-share treaty business so the PYD is attributed at syndicate/treaty level; LOB-specific reserve impacts are not disclosed. Claims development triangle is limited to UW years 2016-2018.
